decisions.reason: Omitting the sensor level-shifter circuitry does not remove or alter any specified sensor-board connector; the connectors remain present.
The source concerns level shifting for sensor I2C and UART connections, not the independently specified addressable-LED power and data interface.
The SPS30 remains configured for I2C operation with SEL connected to GND; its 3.3V logic compatibility does not change that mode requirement.
The panel reset connector and EN-to-GND action are unrelated to sensor logic-level shifting.
The panel button and switch GPIO interfaces are unaffected by removal of the sensor-board level-shifter footprints.
The source does not change the requirement to provide the PIR input connector.
The passive buzzer interface and selected part policy are unrelated to sensor I2C or UART level shifting.
The TTP223 touch inputs and their GPIO assignments are unaffected by the sensor-board level-shifter decision.
The source addresses sensor logic compatibility and does not change the LED array board's count, part, package, or layout requirements.
The main-to-sensor signal connector and its I2C/UART pinout remain unchanged; only optional downstream sensor level-shifter footprints are omitted.
The interboard power topology, connector, and voltage pinout are not changed by the sensor logic-level compatibility decision.
Freeing sensor-board space by omitting level-shifter footprints does not necessarily change any established connector placement or alignment constraint.
